items.title: No March Core Update: Google Discover & Shadow Changes Debunked
items.summary: SEO veteran Charles Floate debunks rumors of a March 2026 core update, pointing instead to a recent Google Discover update and last month's shadow update as culprits for ranking shifts. He highlights devalued content signals, rising importance of entities, links, root authority, and SERP intent matching, which ungrounded AI content struggles with. Google maintains consistent quality signals, disproportionately affecting low-effort AI-generated output.

items.title: End of Traditional SEO: Rise of GEO and Search Everywhere Optimization
items.summary: Gazi Masud declares the 20-year era of keyword SEO and backlinks over, as AI tools like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity answer queries directly, boosting impressions but slashing clicks. He champions Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) focusing on AI citability via structured content, E-E-A-T, and unique data. A 2026 checklist urges proprietary data, multi-platform optimization, and human-authored content.

items.title: OKARA Launches World's First AI CMO for SEO and Content at $99/Mo
items.summary: Mario Nawfal spotlights OKARA's groundbreaking AI CMO launch: paste a URL to auto-deploy agents handling SEO, Reddit, X, HN, content, and more—for $99/month versus $60k–$160k human salaries. The announcement exploded with 100k+ views and lively debates on AI disrupting marketing teams. While hyped as revolutionary, some users report inconsistencies in competitor analysis.

items.title: Google Tests AI-Generated Headlines in Search After Discover Success
items.summary: Google is running a limited test of AI-rewritten headlines in standard search results to align better with queries and drive engagement, mirroring its quick pivot from Discover experiment to feature. Unlike rule-based rewrites, this generative AI crafts novel phrasing absent from originals, without disclosure or opt-out for publishers. SEO pros warn of eroding headline control across Google surfaces, urging vigilant monitoring amid trust risks.

items.title: Google AI Mode Personalizes for Free Users, Clarifies Crawl Limits
items.summary: Google rolled out Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to all free US users, pulling from Gmail and Photos for tailored responses that vary by individual, challenging uniform SEO benchmarking. Googlebot crawl limits hover around a practical 2MB threshold despite 15MB claims, guiding optimizations for content-heavy pages. AI Overviews slash top organic CTR by 59% in tests, with small publishers suffering 60% referral traffic drops amid rising AI dominance.

items.title: 5 Proven GEO Strategies to Dominate AI Search Brand Recommendations
items.summary: Geoptie shares five GEO tactics: track AI visibility via customer Q&A queries, bolster core SEO for foundational rankings, enhance citability with data-backed claims, schema, and clusters, engage authentically on Reddit, and pitch listicles to authority sites. AI engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity favor top Google/Reddit sources, evolving AEO/GEO into must-haves for 2026 visibility. Free tools like GEO audits and rank trackers empower early adoption.

items.title: Horror book "Shy Girl" pulled by publisher over author allegedly using AI to write it
items.summary: Hachette Book Group pulled the horror novel 'Shy Girl' by Mia Ballard after allegations surfaced that AI was used to generate parts of the text. This incident highlights growing concerns in the publishing industry about AI involvement in writing. The post links to an article detailing the controversy.

items.title: Joe makes $5,000/month publishing AI audiobooks on autopilot
items.summary: A busy entrepreneur uses AI to create and narrate audiobooks on popular topics, publishing them across platforms for passive income of $5k/month after initial compounding sales. The process involves minimal daily effort using tools like Claude and ChatGPT. The poster shares a free system proven for $50k/month generation.

items.title: Best writing on AI revolution found in classic books like Dickens and Bronte
items.summary: Bloomberg recommends reading traditional novels about the industrial revolution, such as works by Dickens and Bronte, over modern AI memos to understand AI's future impact. These stories provide valuable insights into technological shifts. The post promotes non-AI literature for deeper perspectives.

items.title: A.I. Is Writing Fiction. Publishers Are Unprepared.
items.summary: The book publishing industry has few safeguards against unwittingly releasing AI-generated novels. Hachette's Orbit imprint canceled the release of 'Shy Girl' after suspicions of heavy AI use emerged. Industry experts note readers and writers strongly oppose such technology in fiction.

items.title: Publisher pulls horror novel 'Shy Girl' over AI concerns
items.summary: Hachette Book Group will not publish 'Shy Girl,' originally self-published in 2025 and acquired for US release this spring, due to evidence of AI-generated text. The decision followed an internal investigation prompted by public concerns. This underscores tensions around AI in professional publishing.

items.title: Publisher Pulls 'Shy Girl' Horror Novel After AI Allegations
items.summary: Hachette canceled US publication of 'Shy Girl' following reader complaints and an investigation revealing AI involvement. The book had already been released in the UK. This case raises questions about detection processes in traditional publishing pipelines.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan Wins Best Actor at 2026 Oscars for 'Sinners'
items.summary: Michael B. Jordan secured his first Oscar for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for his role in 'Sinners.' He defied historical precedents and honored past Black winners like Sidney Poitier in his speech. The ceremony on March 15 highlighted major wins including for 'One Battle After Another.'

items.title: Sony and Pop Mart Team Up for Labubu Movie with Paul King Directing
items.summary: Sony Pictures and Pop Mart announced a live-action/CGI feature film based on the popular Labubu collectible toys. Paul King, known for 'Wonka' and 'Paddington,' will direct, co-write the script with Steven Levenson, and produce. The project capitalizes on Labubu's global fanbase.

items.title: Disney Pixar Removes 'Woke' Content Following Protests
items.summary: Disney Pixar has pulled back on 'woke' elements in content after recent protests from audiences. The changes address concerns over ideological themes in family entertainment. This reflects ongoing debates about messaging in animated films.

items.title: Woke Audiences Hype Films but Skip Box Office, Leading to Flops Like The Bride!
items.summary: A review highlights how woke signaling boosts hype for films like The Marvels, Ghostbusters (2016), Birds of Prey, The Bride!, and 1348 Ex Voto without translating to ticket sales. This pattern demonstrates the risks of pandering to such demographics. The post has garnered significant engagement discussing entertainment trends.

items.title: Claims Michael B. Jordan's Oscar Win Was DEI 'Gift' Rather Than Merit
items.summary: A post questions the merit of Michael B. Jordan's Best Actor Oscar, calling it a DEI-driven award. It references his admiration for Sidney Poitier, the first Black winner in 1964. The comment sparks replies amid celebrations of the historic win.

items.title: Entertainment Roundup: Michael B. Jordan Oscar Win, Crayon Label Drama
items.summary: Weekly hotline covers Michael B. Jordan's Best Actor Oscar, Teyana Taylor's backstage drama, Crayon Shinchan's messy Mavin Records split dragging Don Jazzy and Rema, and Papa Ajasco's financial woes. Debates if the posts are PR stunt or genuine conflict. Blends awards glamour with industry realities.

items.title: How Small Businesses Maximize ROI With AI Tools
items.summary: A survey of 431 small business owners reveals that 85% have adopted generative AI, with 65% reporting increased confidence in their company's future and 47% seeing an average 21% revenue boost. AI tools save significant time, such as 175 hours annually on social media content creation, allowing 51% to improve work-life balance and 47% to reduce stress. AI-generated images also drive engagement, with 23% more likes and 20% more profile visits.

items.title: OpenClaw's Paperclip Plugin Lets You Build a Full AI Company on Your Computer
items.summary: OpenClaw's new Paperclip plugin enables users to create an AI CEO, marketing team, and tech team that run 24/7 with real memory on local hardware, eliminating salaries and data privacy risks. It handles tasks autonomously, ideal for small businesses seeking operational automation. Download from GitHub to start with one task and scale your AI workforce.

items.title: 10 Ways Small Businesses Are Using AI That Big Corporations Haven't Mastered
items.summary: Small businesses lead in practical AI adoption, using tools for 24/7 phone answering, cash flow forecasting, bias-free hiring, personalized marketing, and autonomous operations like invoice chasing. Unlike large firms bogged down by bureaucracy, SMBs achieve revenue boosts and hire more staff, with 68% running AI daily. Examples include competitor spying and no-code automations, proving speed trumps scale.
